data.title: Two weeks on the counter wall
data.goal: Two weeks on the counter wall

memoryNodes.cue: Jay adjusts the work and storage.

data.situation:
In late May, a nearby school asked for bags for its summer fair. There was a surge in orders, and Jay added a second sheet to the wall calendar. Sales of jewellery, however, showed a decline after the market weekend. Mina did not assume both lines would keep moving in the same direction. The school order could boost bag sales for one week without changing the rest of the summer. When orders began to stabilise, Jay moved the finished school bags off the counter and into the stockroom. The unused space there began to shrink. Faster cutting might accelerate production, but they still checked every handle. At closing time, Noor stood back from the calendar. Two busy weeks were enough to change their plans, but not enough to tell them everything about the shop. ORDER NOTES — 19–30 MAY
School bags: sudden rise after the school enquiry.
Jewellery: fewer sales than at the market weekend.
Repair requests: little change in the second week.
Next week: review these notes before accepting another large order.

readingBlocks.zh: 五月下旬，附近学校为夏季集市订购包。订单激增，杰伊在墙上日历旁加了一张纸。不过市场周末之后，首饰销量下降了。米娜没有假设两条走势会一直朝同一方向变化。学校订单可以提高一周的卖包销量，却不一定改变整个夏季。订单开始稳定后，杰伊把做好的学校用包从柜台搬进库房，那里的闲置空间开始减少。加快裁剪可能加快生产，但每个提手仍要检查。关门时，努尔退后看日历。两个忙碌的星期足以改变计划，却不足以说明小店的一切。

readingBlocks.en:
ORDER NOTES — 19–30 MAY
School bags: sudden rise after the school enquiry.
Jewellery: fewer sales than at the market weekend.
Repair requests: little change in the second week.
Next week: review these notes before accepting another large order.
readingBlocks.zh:
订单记录——五月十九日至三十日
学校用包：学校询价后突然增加。
首饰：销量少于市场周末。
维修要求：第二周变化不大。
下周：接受下一笔大订单前，再看这些记录。

glossary.note: a surge in orders：订单激增；a surge 是一次突然的大幅增加。
glossary.example: There was a surge in school orders.
glossary.exampleZh: 学校订单突然大幅增加。

externalEvidence.definition: a sudden or abrupt strong increase

glossary.note: a decline in sales：销量下降；a decline 是名词，sales decline 中 decline 是动词。
glossary.example: Jewellery sales showed a decline after the weekend.

externalEvidence.definition: change toward something smaller or lower

glossary.note: 本句不及物；英式 stabilise，美式 stabilize 是同一单位拼写。
glossary.example: Orders began to stabilise after the busy week.
glossary.exampleZh: 忙碌一周后，订单开始稳定。

glossary.note: shrink–shrank–shrunk；原市场缩小例句为同一减少义，不另计每种主语。
glossary.example: The unused space in the stockroom began to shrink.
glossary.exampleZh: 库房闲置空间开始减少。

externalEvidence.definition: decrease in size, range, or extent

glossary.note: accelerate a process；本句不是车辆提速，但共享使加快的核心。
glossary.exampleZh: 更快裁剪可能加快生产。

glossary.note: boost sales/confidence：提高销量／增强信心。
glossary.example: The school order could boost bag sales.
glossary.exampleZh: 学校订单可能提高卖包销量。

externalEvidence.definition: give a boost to; be beneficial to
